messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: nanoscan3-manual, p. 74

8 CONFIGURATION If you have activated the Reference contour monitoring option for a monitoring plane, the Reference contour field dialog box is displayed. The contour as reference field monitors a contour of the environment. The safety laser scanner switches all safety outputs to the OFF state if a contour does not match the set parameters, because, for example, the mounting of the safety laser scanner has been changed. Drawing a reference contour field 1. Select the tool for drawing reference contour fields. 2. First, use the mouse to click the desired contour. 3. Click to add the corners of the contour. 4. Finally, double-click the contour. m The reference contour field is displayed. Multiple sampling and Object resolution At first, the object resolution and multiple sampling configured for the monitoring plane apply for all fields. If necessary, you can make changes to each individually at a later date. Tolerance band A contour has a positive and a negative tolerance band. If the safety laser scanner does not detect the contour within the tolerance band, the field switches to the OFF state. O Positive tolerance (far): The tolerance away from the safety laser scanner O Negative tolerance (near): The tolerance toward the safety laser scanner 74 nanoScan3 I/O 8024596/1W27/2026-05-26 | SICK SUBJECT TO CHANGE WITHOUT NOTICE
